name: General Co. For Silos & Storage
source: CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | General Silos & Storage (GSSC.CA), Egyptian Exchange disclosure summary for the financial year 01/07/2025 to 30/06/2026, filed 27 October 2026: comparative net profit for FY2025 265,160,968 EGP, audited. Mirror: https://foudalens.com/en/news/296579 (EGX NewsID 296579). The statement rows in this file were stored in EGP thousands while labelled EGP, a 1000x overstatement corrected on 18 Nov 2026; the correction is confirmed by the filing's own net profit for FY2025 (265.16 billion in the file, 265,160,968 EGP on the disclosure sheet) and by EPS 15.152 on 17.5 million shares. Revenue 1,487.77 million and net finance costs 84.67 million also match investing.com's EGP million income statement for the year to 30/06/2025. Income Tax set to Profit Before Tax minus Net Profit so the identity ties after the rescale.
